'''Garan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] ventured to the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to meet with the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Tyno Fabris]]. Just as Pavan was introduced to Fabris, Garan scanned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with a [[weapons sensor]] and declared that he was unarmed.
